slides.title: News Feed Overview
content: A news feed is a continuously updating list of posts from followed users
Displays posts in reverse chronological order
Includes text, images, videos, and links

slides.title: Core Features
content: Users can view posts from friends or followers
Feed is sorted by most recent posts first

slides.title: System Requirements
content: System must handle millions of daily active users

slides.title: System Architecture
content: System is divided into publishing and feed building flows
Publishing flow handles new post creation
Feed building flow retrieves posts for users

slides.title: APIs
content: POST API is used to create new posts
GET API is used to fetch user feed

slides.title: Publishing Flow
content: Web server validates and authenticates user
Post is stored in database and cache
Fanout service distributes post to followers

slides.title: Feed Retrieval Flow
content: Feed data is fetched from cache
Posts are returned to user quickly

slides.title: Fanout on Write
content: Posts are pushed to followers when created
Not suitable for users with many followers

slides.title: Fanout on Read
content: Feed is generated when user requests it
Better for users with large follower counts

slides.title: Caching Strategy
content: Feed data stored in cache for faster access

slides.title: Important Concepts
content: Reverse chronological order shows latest posts first
Write amplification occurs when one action triggers many writes

slides.title: Scalability Factors
content: System must support millions of users

slides.title: Challenges
content: Handling users with millions of followers

slides.title: Final Summary
content: News feed systems manage large-scale content distribution
Fanout strategy is key design decision
Hybrid approach balances scalability and efficiency
